---
title: Bad link text
---

A key prefix [reddit-2026-bad-key](https://example.com/reddit).

A short x key [x-short](https://example.com/xkey).

A handle [note @handle](https://example.com/handle).

A bare link [https://example.com/bare](https://example.com/bare).

A www link [www.example.com/plain](https://example.com/www).

An autolink <https://example.com/auto>.

One long token [abcdefghijklmnopqrstu](https://example.com/token).
